meta.name: detecting-shadow-api-endpoints
meta.description: Discover and inventory shadow API endpoints that operate outside documented specifications using traffic analysis, code scanning, and API discovery platforms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并盘点未记录的影子API端点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要确保所有API端点都有文档且受监控
copy.tagline_en: Discover and inventory undocumented shadow API endpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure all API endpoints are documented and monitored

howto.what: Claude 会指导你通过分析 API 流量日志、扫描云配置（如 AWS API Gateway）和搜索源代码，找出未记录在文档中的 API 端点（Shadow API）。
howto.when: 当你需要调查安全事件、构建检测规则或验证 API 安全监控覆盖时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出系统中未记录的 API 端点。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供流量日志或云配置信息。

say.text: 分析我的 AWS API Gateway 配置，发现隐藏的 API。
say.note: Claude 会指导你运行相关 AWS CLI 命令。

say.text: 扫描我的 Python 代码，找到未文档化的路由。
say.note: Claude 会提供 grep 命令来搜索路由定义。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to discover undocumented API endpoints by analyzing traffic logs, scanning cloud configurations (e.g., AWS API Gateway), and searching source code for routes not in OpenAPI specs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to investigate security incidents, build detection rules, or validate API security monitoring coverage.

say_en.text: Find undocumented API endpoints in my system.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for traffic logs or cloud configs.

say_en.text: Scan my AWS API Gateway for hidden APIs.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through AWS CLI commands.

say_en.text: Search my Python code for undocumented routes.
say_en.note: Claude provides grep commands for route definitions.
